name: dsh-tool-insurance
description: Insurance Actuarial Engine - Premium calculation, claims prediction, risk scoring, reserving analysis, fraud detection, catastrophe modeling, life table analysis, reinsurance optimization

skills.name: Premium Calculator
skills.description: Calculate insurance premiums based on risk profile. Computes base premium, risk loading factors, applicable discounts, and payment options including monthly/quarterly/annual splits.
examples: Use Premium Calculator to calculate insurance premiums based on risk profile. Computes base premium, risk loading factors, applicable discounts, and payment options including monthly/quarterly/annual splits.
Can you run Premium Calculator? Risk Profile is the main input I have.
Invoke Premium Calculator with the relevant data and return the formatted result.

skills.name: Claims Predictor
skills.description: Predict future claims at the portfolio level using historical data. Provides loss ratio, frequency/severity decomposition, emerging risk identification, and stress test scenarios.
examples: Use Claims Predictor to predict future claims at the portfolio level using historical data. Provides loss ratio, frequency/severity decomposition, emerging risk identification, and stress test scenarios.
Can you run Claims Predictor? Portfolio Data is the main input I have.
Invoke Claims Predictor with the relevant data and return the formatted result.

skills.name: Risk Scorer
skills.description: Score insurance applicants across multiple risk dimensions. Returns risk score, risk classification, exclusion riders, premium loading, and decline probability.
examples: Use Risk Scorer to score insurance applicants across multiple risk dimensions. Returns risk score, risk classification, exclusion riders, premium loading, and decline probability.
Can you run Risk Scorer? Applicant Data is the main input I have.
Invoke Risk Scorer with the relevant data and return the formatted result.

skills.name: Reserve Analyzer
skills.description: Analyze claims reserves for adequacy. Estimates incurred but not reported (IBNR), calculates development patterns, and identifies surplus or shortfall positions.
examples: Use Reserve Analyzer to analyze claims reserves for adequacy. Estimates incurred but not reported (IBNR), calculates development patterns, and identifies surplus or shortfall positions.

Invoke Reserve Analyzer with the relevant data and return the formatted result.

examples: Use Fraud Detection Scorer to score insurance claims for fraud probability. Identifies red flags, assigns investigation priority, and estimates potential savings from investigation.

examples: Use Catastrophe Modeler to model catastrophe losses for a given peril. Generates loss exceedance curves, probable maximum loss, average annual loss, and reinsurance layer recommendations.
